items.architectureDecision: Sequential trusted startup page, finalized/deleted startup artifact, then sole application page in the same persistent context is the selected design. Moving run origin earlier is rejected because it exposes diagnostic frames and changes timing/deadline semantics.
items.severity: HIGH: app-video evidence and timing correctness; current startup diagnostic screens are recorded before run origin.
items.owner: R runner; root serializes final gates and releases exact scope after fresh Pax
requiredPrivateLifecycle: BOOTSTRAP: assert exactly one startup page; fixed trusted WebUI navigation/limited effective preference projection only. Guard unexpected pages from the first post-launch inspection, with no arbitrary-page exception window.

CLOSED_STARTUP: capture startup page-owned video capability; close startup page; bounded await native finalization and confined deletion; confirm no remaining page and no retained startup artifact before newPage. Only the specifically issued newPage operation is authorized; any other event/page fails.

APP: create exactly one about:blank page, bind CDP isolated blank-world capability to this page, install ordinary popup refusal and return only this page to the child. No bootstrap page/element/world is reused as source evidence. Latch every unexpected-page event and refuse readiness even if it occurs before the child registers onExtraPage; never drop an early callback or clear the latch during page replacement.

Child takes the existing paired wall/monotonic origin exactly once after factory app-readiness, checks actual blank identity and liveness, then Ready. No browser secret execution or observation precedes Ready. Application video may have a measured bounded blank prefix; removing diagnostic video alone does not prove seek calibration.

StartDeadline covers launch/probe/close/delete/app readiness. Absolute admission runDeadline and parent process-tree deadline remain continuous. Runtime budget uses existing admitted totalRuntime/window; no extension, reset, fresh grant, early RUNNING or new origin field.

On any bootstrap failure/cancel/deadline: fail closed before Ready, dispose actual context/browser; parent bounds/forces process-tree teardown and clears scratch/capacity. Late launch resolution after stop is disposed. No orphan video upload, chosen stray-file fallback, swallowed deletion error or indefinite page-video wait.

Factory close returns only actual app page video after awaited app/context closure. Native geometry, evidence-vs-outcome, actual partial rules, upload/manifest key derivation and masking policy are unchanged. Do not use broad best-effort removeStrayRecordings as startup proof.
items.acceptanceDelta: Literal one-page-over-entire-context/no-second-page language and single-page recording lifecycle need an explicit sequential startup exception. Preserve one active page/context and exactly one application recording. App readiness refines recording readiness; no new wire contract.
items.reversibility: Before root release this is report-only. After authorized implementation, revert the isolated factory lifecycle change and its regenerated byte identities if proof fails; retain diagnostic contamination as an open failure, never hide it by shifting/rebasing/rewriting video.
items.evidenceDisposition: NEEDS_EVIDENCE: pinned full Chromium supports closing/finalizing/deleting startup native video while context remains alive; no implementation/probe for replacement currently credited.

items.severity: HIGH: required terminal summary missing for authentic accepted declarations after possible read/controller loss or generic pre-resolver terminal closure.
items.architectureDecision: Add terminal-winner proof distinct from the live-owned completed-resolution no-send receipt. Classify only accepted declared IDs without a committed resolution using enforced read-entry protocol and actual pre-send terminal CAS: no read-entry with positive protocol/zero-send proof→NOT_USED; exact read-entry with no committed resolution→UNKNOWN_OUTCOME. Neither is a resolution outcome or execution/retry authority.
items.owner: B backend caller/lifecycle, Dara data guard/retention/partition design; root release after fresh Pax. Existing serialized handles remain with their owners.

consumer: Existing names-only audit queries/retention and owner terminal lifecycle; no RunnerReport, RunJob, admission request, BridgeOutcome or public projection field changes.

minimalProposedDataContract.receiptFamily: Separate internal studio_observed_terminal_secret_settlements proposed, not implemented. Do not widen studio_observed_no_send_decisions live-lease guard or its outage-only REQUEUED semantics.
minimalProposedDataContract.fields: id, occurred_at; exact execution_id/execution_accepted_at, accepted attempt_id, revision_id/revision_digest/binding_digest/scope_hash, principal_id/csi_id/environment/test_id; actual preceding_state, terminal_error_code/terminal_error_at; bounded unique possible_read_ids and positively_no_read_ids for still-unsettled declarations. Every field/set is constructed and independently checked from locked authoritative rows and immutable declarations, never a caller boolean. No value/value digest/provider body, borrowed lease owner, admission, ordinal, release/version/sequence or new wire status.
minimalProposedDataContract.identity: Receipt unique per execution/accepted-history/accepted attempt; unlinked summary identity per that exact tuple + declared secret, independent of caller sequence/time/partition. Read-entry creator metadata stays immutable across actual owners; a changed/retried binding cannot relabel earlier evidence.
minimalProposedDataContract.rowShape: USAGE only, path OBSERVED_REPLAY, actual accepted attempt nonnull. Unlinked NOT_USED or UNKNOWN_OUTCOME requires null outcome/release_id/release_seq/vault_version/admission_id/source_reference_id/coordinate_step_id/coordinate_ordinal; occurrence timestamp is a retention locator, never a fictional release time. Exact immutable declaration/scope authenticated. ACK_LOST is excluded.
minimalProposedDataContract.guard: Capture authentic pre-transition QUEUED/CLAIMED/no dispatch attempt/admission/observed receipt under the owner row lock. Terminal winner alone may create proof. Receipt, terminal state/history, and complete new summaries share one physical transaction; deferred leaf guard verifies actual current transaction owner-row version and exact terminal locator/identity/facts. Savepoint/subtransaction row-version behavior must be proven or prohibited, never assumed from top-level transaction labels. Failed or losing transitions/receipt-only commits roll back all writes. At receipt insertion the database guard independently verifies the actual locked pre-transition row and captures/compares its before-image; a caller-supplied preceding_state is insufficient. Do not authorize direct receipt insert against an already-DONE row merely because it has the same error label.
minimalProposedDataContract.classification: Under owner-row lock, obtain a fresh authoritative read-entry view after any waited-for writer completes (avoid stale statement-snapshot absence). Compute remaining accepted IDs after authentic existing decisions/summaries. Partition them into exact scoped durable possible-read markers and positively no-read IDs under universally enforced write-before-read. Terminal state fences future read-entry/dispatched release; the successful pre-send transition fences sends. Neither set alone proves a physical read count.
minimalProposedDataContract.knownFacts: Settle all existing authentic scoped RELEASE rows via existing linked UNKNOWN or authentic refusal/no-effect facts; preserve early USED and every committed positive. Do not append new unlinked rows for linked/already summarized IDs, repeat a summary or mutate history. Missing required RELEASE after dispatch is a lineage error outside this new shape.
minimalProposedDataContract.retentionAndLocks: Append-only parent/leaf UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE guards, no DEFAULT partition, bounded 12-month Q3 retention aligned with audit/read evidence, current/future partition bootstrap/pruner coverage. Owner row→owner advisory→event locks, cross-month stable dedup and concurrent classification/link rejection. No retention-blocking self-FK or permanent row-version identity; xmin is same-transaction proof only.

requiredCallerSemantics: All actual terminal winners, including requestCancel immediate DONE, generic closeWithError, pending reaper expiry, kill-switch/dispatch-disabled closure and admitted cancel/reconciliation when applicable, invoke settlement in the same winning physical transaction. Merely recording a cancel request for DISPATCHING/ADMITTED/RUNNING is not terminal permission.

Do not impersonate expired CLAIMED owners through lockObservedResolutionOwner; cancellation/reaper use their actual existing terminal authority and exact accepted binding. No extra provider call, browser send, lease refresh, grant or retry.

No marker plus no FINAL/decision is insufficient without the enforced protocol and actual zero-send terminal cut. If protocol coverage or binding/transition proof is unavailable, retain explicit unmet completeness/NEEDS_EVIDENCE; never emit a negative guess.

Controller loss after marker/before call and after actual read/before committed decision both settle UNKNOWN. Marker does not reveal which happened. Tests use independent provider counters and actual crash barriers to distinguish them.
Keep existing genuine outage/fresh retry and definite transport refusal unchanged; all prior known/linked facts and retries retain exact authentic attempts. Terminal receipt is CLOSED-only.

Make requestCancel immediate closure and any affected close/reconcile public entrypoint actually transactional with the audit/receipt append; do not rely on self-invoked proxy annotations. An external caller transaction must also cover rollback on injected audit failure. Preserve exact cancel/reaper state-matrix semantics and no append on request-only/losing transitions.
items.acceptanceDelta: Current AC14/design4.1 explicitly allow three variants and exclude crash-after-possible-read. Add observed no-committed-decision uncertainty as fourth variant and expand third variant only with the new terminal-winning guarded no-read/no-send proof. New database row/producer authority requires fresh independent Pax; not an implementation shortcut.
items.reversibility: Report only until PO/root. Owners should isolate the new receipt/guard/caller adapter. If proof fails, stop scope and preserve old unmet completeness; never backfill guessed usage or delete historical rows. Append-only data changes are not reversed by mutating accepted history; pre-release baseline changes require existing ADR authority and owner-managed regression.

items.severity: HIGH: successful resolver facts can be discarded before dispatch by current refusal/ownership loss.
items.architectureDecision: Capture bounded immutable per-ID actual RESOLVED/version metadata immediately after successful resolvedJob construction, before the owned check/begin transaction and before array close. On a subsequent genuine pre-send refusal, carry only these safe facts to the existing winning live-owner atomic settlement and produce actual RELEASE plus linked REFUSED. The existing approved shape already permits genuine resolved-but-refused values. No canonical acceptance delta or new wire shape is needed.
items.owner: B backend, using already root-released actual resolution/linked no-send scope; root controls any broader change
exactRemediation: Copy only authenticated declared IDs, actual DecisionOutcome.RESOLVED and validated opaque version identifiers from the successful Resolved before any later check can throw. Preserve exact accepted binding/attempt; do not retain values, RunJob, origins, raw exceptions, value hashes or new read/send operations for bookkeeping. Existing ResolvedJob.close still erases arrays on every exit.

If current cancellation/revocation/refusal happens before begin succeeds and the same live CLAIMED owner wins: append the real decisions and linked pre-send REFUSED and close in one physical caller transaction, with cancel/revocation precedence. Do not relabel actual RESOLVED as a fabricated REVOKED resolution solely from terminal state.

If began=0, owner expired, wrong owner/attempt or a terminal winner already committed: loser appends nothing and cannot borrow terminal authority or late append safe transient facts. The actual terminal winner uses only independently authenticated durable facts; if resolution was never committed, proposed B terminal shape is needed.

If begin/sendCommitted already succeeded, existing actual RELEASE/uncertainty/recovery stays authoritative; no refusal reinterpretation, resend or replay of old RunJob. Throwing after an audited write rolls back audit and state together.

Add actual dispatcher-path tests for successful real provider read followed by owned-check cancellation/revocation; verify exact retained RESOLVED/version plus linked REFUSED, arrays erased, sendCount0 and one summary. Add began=0/barrier/stale-owner loser tests and audit rollback; a direct helper-only test does not prove dispatchObserved integration.

Successful resolution→current owned refusal and began=0 production caller integration; marker/no-decision UNKNOWN and zero-read/no-send NOT_USED both positive and negative variants.

Fresh final-source lane peer re-review and root-serialized full regression; all19AC/SEC/C, CoreHTTP/PG/countedVault/compiled child/full Chromium joins, native/injected/supplementary C6 and complete stdout/stderr/relay/failure/manifest/callback/journals/parent-log scans.
